summary: Beacon Financial Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $175,000,000 offering of 6.25% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036, issued under an existing shelf registration. The notes mature September 1, 2036, pay 6.25% fixed interest until 2031, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 215 basis points. The registrant is the issuer, not a target or acquirer. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation. Pricing terms include 100% of par, underwriting discount of 1.25%, and net proceeds of $172,812,500. No special-situation mechanics apply.
